title_en: Information Session on Recruitment for the 2027 Entrepreneurial Engineering Innovation Talent Program
summary: The Seoul National University College of Engineering Innovation and Startup Center (서울공대혁신창업센터) will hold an information session on recruitment for the 2027 Entrepreneurial Engineering Innovation Talent program. Interested students are encouraged to attend on Monday, 9 November 2026, from 15:00 to 16:00 in Room B103, Building 39, College of Engineering. Attendance is optional.
applies_to: Any interested student; attendance is voluntary and not mandatory. The notice states no other eligibility limits for attending the session.

dates.what: Information session on the 2027 Entrepreneurial Engineering Innovation Talent program recruitment (open to interested students)

translation:
[Promotion] Information Session on Recruitment for the 2027 Entrepreneurial Engineering Innovation Talent Program

The Seoul National University College of Engineering Innovation and Startup Center (서울공대혁신창업센터) will hold an information session on recruitment for the 2027 Entrepreneurial Engineering Innovation Talent program as follows. Interested students are encouraged to participate.

A. Event: Information Session on Recruitment for the 2027 Entrepreneurial Engineering Innovation Talent Program

B. Date and time: Monday, 9 November 2026, 15:00–16:00

C. Venue: Room B103, Building 39, College of Engineering

D. Main contents:
- Introduction to the College of Engineering Entrepreneurial Innovation Talent program
- Information on recruitment and selection for the 2027 program, etc.

E. Inquiries: College of Engineering Innovation and Startup Center (contact details are given in the original notice)

Attachment: Information session announcement, 1 copy.

Attached file (1): 2027년도 창업가형 혁신인재 모집 설명회 개최 안내.pdf (55 KB). The content of this attachment was not provided in the text and has not been read.
